name: Zombieman
source:
The protagonist is a intelligent zombie who likes to spend time with his friends. From all the demons in hell, he is the only one who has an actual gender, although because of formerly being a human, he is the weakest of them.
Like his friends, Zombieman hopes to find a date for the Icon of Sin festival.
